positions.assessment: Gofu and Sudri are on the field and the hand holds Sharnga, Dark Armed Dragon and Delta Crow. Vata is the only search that leads to Black-Winged Dragon. Vata Special Summons itself off Sudri and sends itself plus Deck Blackwings for BWD. BWD's 2800 ATK then lets Sharnga come down, Sharnga + Sudri make Boreastorm, and Boreastorm at Lv2 + BWD make Full Armor Master, then Assault Dragon. The other searches don't come close to that.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Vata is the right search. It gives BWD, turns on Sharnga, and leads to the Boreastorm → Full Armor Master + Assault Dragon line, exactly as the reason lays out.

positions.assessment: Simoon resolved past the Solemn Strike this time. Normal Summoning it triggers Black Whirlwind's search (Sudri), and this summon doesn't use up the regular Normal Summon. Sending it to the GY would waste the whole engine.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Correct: the free Normal Summon triggers the Black Whirlwind search and keeps the real Normal Summon.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Correct, with the right plan to search Sudri and then Normal Summon it.

positions.assessment: Armor Master survived its attack on the stolen Assault Dragon, so it can place a Wedge Counter. That is the same counter (0x1002) Full Armor Master checks, and FAM can take control of any opponent's monster with a Wedge Counter. So in Main Phase 2, FAM can take Assault Dragon back, and Crackdown is destroyed once Assault leaves the opponent's field. Placing the counter is clearly right.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: This misses that a Wedge Counter lets Full Armor Master take back the 3200-ATK Assault Dragon in Main Phase 2. It throws away the chance to recover a key monster.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Right: the counter sets up Full Armor Master's steal to recover Assault Dragon.
